name: Product walkthrough videos

steps.action: Validate facts, rights, format and exact revision
Hand off approved artifact; recipient rechecks release controls

gate: Exact artifact, rights and intended handoff approved?
acceptance_tests: Source-specific deliverable checked: Demo video; data/privacy QA
Material changes invalidate approval; destination remains staged until final release
Duplicate or uncertain external result uses X06, not blind retry
notes: Original V6 identity, trigger, source procedure and deliverable retained. Stage role labels and common controls are V7 consolidation design refinements. This workflow does not itself authorize an external send, call or spend.
failure: Keep the revision unpublished. Preserve evidence and failure status, request a new reviewed revision, and never retry an ambiguous publication without checking the destination.
source_procedure: Capture compliant walkthrough; script explanation; edit and annotate

run_contract.owner: Assigned accountable role in OpenProject before activation
run_contract.retry: Bounded retry only after retryability classification; unknown remote effects HOLD
run_contract.observability: workflow_id, run_id, correlation_id, state and redacted error; no raw PII labels
run_contract.recovery: Restore HOLD; reapply suppression/deletion and reconcile external receipts before replay
run_contract.completion: Named output plus acceptance evidence, not merely a running service
